nu `source` runs a sourced file's `def main` when FABRO_STAGE is set: the /tmp probe sourcing `scripts/verify.nu` accidentally executed stage-implementer against the temp fixture after its assertions (transcript run 01M5CSS93MRRW1N82N5SQ26BVM records it). Anyone writing verify.nu probes should set FABRO_STAGE='' or copy the defs, or the probe silently runs a real cargo pass.

The seed body's original premise (develop prompts step 4/6) was superseded by the 2026-10-11 sweep to `scripts/verify.nu` only; planner.md step 6 carries no full-suite language today, so no mirror edit was needed beyond implementer.md's single tier-description sentence.

painpoints.text: The prior implementer pass (run 01M5CSS93MRRW1N82N5SQ26BVM, commit 3857e224a) skipped one of the three seed-named loop-asset paths (planner.md step 6) and still routed 'Implemented' — the omission surfaced only at the tester's seed-spec-paths tier, costing a full gate run plus this bounce pass. Fix idea: implementer prompt (or loop-gate cheap tier) should run the seed-spec-paths check at implementer time against the seed body's named paths before routing, the same way run-scope is offered as an early verdict.

observations: seed-spec-paths derives its path list from free text in the seed body ('Mirror in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md step 6') — a brief that paraphrases the spec without the literal path would pass implementer review yet still RED the gate; the mechanical list is authoritative and cheap to consult (this pass read it straight from the tester output).
